# About Me:
## 👋 Hi, I'm Saif Eldeen Sobhi<br><br>Full-Stack Developer from Cairo, focused on the backend with Node.js. I build secure APIs, real-time features and scalable web apps, from the database to the UI with React and Next.js. Passionate about clean code, problem-solving, and continuous learning.<br><br>
### Tech Stack<br><br>- **Backend:** Node.js, TypeScript, Express.js, RESTful APIs, Socket.io, JWT.<br>- **Databases:**  MongoDB (Mongoose ODM), SQL (Sequelize ORM), Redis.<br>- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript.<br>- **Payments & Services:** Stripe, Cloudinary.<br>- **Deployment:** Vercel, Render, Heroku, GitHub Actions.<br>- **Tools:** Git, GitHub, Postman, Swagger.<br><br>
